features: TOUCHES THE DATABASE — One new table, «righe_riparto», and two columns of «rate_quote» dropped because never written nor read (riga_fattura_id, voce_id). Two migrations, both re-runnable. And one behaviour change at generation: a single-unit expense with no active owner, bare owner or usufructuary to charge now stops generation like any other uncovered amount and asks for a reason; before, the engine dropped it with a log warning and the plan was generated short of that amount.

THE APPORTIONMENT STOPS BEING A RECALCULATION — The engine knows the account, table, share value, resolved role, ownership share and invoice line of every cent, and used to throw them away right after: rate_quote kept only the total, and the two apportionment prints rebuilt everything at print time with two different arithmetics (Codes 77 and 78: cents in «Unallocated», discounts declared for contributions recorded after issue, detached owners vanishing from one print and staying in the other). Now the detail is written once, at generation, in the same transaction as the instalment shares — one row per component, the already-paid as a negative row, the ad personam with its invoice line — and for each person the rows sum exactly to their share, otherwise nothing is written. The prints read: no arithmetic at print time.

THE DOCUMENT SAYS WHAT IT IS LOOKING AT — In the legend and the legal note: «apportionment recorded at generation on …», or «rebuilt from current data, not recorded» for plans generated before the update (which stay that way: issued plans are not regenerated and keep printing as before), or «preview» for a plan not yet generated. Regenerating a plan replaces the detail, as it replaces the instalments.

WHAT CHANGES IN THE TWO PRINTS — «Direct charge» holds only ad personam expenses (before, the already-paid remainder ended up there: «Direct charge −€ 100.00» for the one owner with a repair of their own). Prior balances get the «Previous balances» column and the already-paid gets «Already paid», in the by-table print too; they count in the block split like other columns. «Unallocated» is a guard: in a recorded print it does not appear. Pseudo-columns always come last. An owner detached after generation keeps their cell with the role of that time; whoever took over later does not appear. An account or table deleted after generation does not lose its column: it stays with the name and shares of that time. Each item's root chapter is frozen. Zero-total persons explained by the detail appear with their cells. A chapter with items on different tables shows «—» instead of a share that does not belong to it. In the by-table print, in a rare case (account on several tables and two resolved roles on the same person), one column may move by one cent, totals unchanged.

THE GUARDS — The register is built beside the totals and does not touch them: the tests that pin the engine (the real 44-unit, 8-table building to the cent, the exact apportionment, edge cases, engine/print concordance) stay green without changing a line. Twenty-five new tests on the register, the write (reconciliation on saved data, regeneration, cascade, rollback both ways) and the prints (Codes 77 and 78 on the measured scenario, the three source states, column order, deleted account and table, frozen root). Four tests cleaned of real people's and buildings' names, figures unchanged.

WHAT REMAINS — A takeover made before generation stays charged to the current owner (contributi_versati.anagrafica_id exists and the engine does not read it): closed with the takeover betas, in this version. Intervention type and main-home flag are not frozen yet: they belong to entities the data model does not have. Income accounts remain an engine defect, not a print one.
